text:
samir: Heads-up — customer acme-co filed a priority ticket: charges and duplicate side-effects after our tool-call retried. They say the payments gateway was hit twice for the same operation.

ingrid: Ugh. Do we have logs linking Redwood tool-call retries to the external POST?

alex: I pulled the runtime logs. Short snippet: 
```
[1768123456] tool-exec: start call func=process_payment args={\"order_id\":\"ord_123\",\"amount\":100}
[1768123457] tool-exec: upstream 502 on attempt=1 -> retrying
[1768123459] tool-exec: attempt=2 -> executed POST https://payments.acme/gateways/process status=200 id=pay_789
[1768123460] tool-exec: result returned to model
```

maria: So attempt 1 failed (502) and we retried and it succeeded on attempt 2 — but the gateway also processed attempt 1? Customer says they got two charges.

samir: The gateway's logs show two separate charge ids: pay_456 and pay_789. Looks like the first attempt actually completed even though it returned 502 to us.

jordan: This matches a known class: upstream returns non-2xx after having side-effected, and our executor retries -> duplicate effect. We need idempotency.

ingrid: Customer code is calling 'process_payment' via function-calling. Their payload sometimes omits `idempotency_key` because model-generated args are inconsistent (schema mismatch). Example request body they sent: 
```
POST /v1/respond
{ "model": "r-infer-1", "messages": [...], "functions": [{"name":"process_payment","parameters":{...}}], "function_call": {"name":"process_payment","arguments":"{\"order_id\": \"ord_123\", \"amount\":100 }"} }
```

alex: Key point: model occasionally omits idempotency arg due to schema validation error when it re-renders args after a retry suggestion. So when the runtime retries, the second call had an idempotency_key (because the model produced it on attempt 2), but attempt 1 had none.

maria: Oof. So ordering of model arg generation + network failure -> duplicates. Immediate mitigation?

opsbot: action_required: disable_auto_retries_for_tools(customer=acme-co) suggestion queued by @samir

samir: For immediate relief: I disabled automatic retries on the customer project and asked them to implement a client-side idempotency header. That should stop us from reissuing the same function call inside the runtime.

jordan: Long-term fixes:
- enforce function-calling to always include an idempotency token generated by the runtime (e.g., X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key) OR require the function schema to declare a mandatory `idempotency_key` param that the runtime fills.
- do not retry on status codes that are known to be "uncertain" (e.g., 500/502 after request accepted) unless idempotency is present.
- add server-side dedupe: attach call_id to tool-runner and don't re-run if same call_id already executed.

alex: Also: improve schema validation flow. Right now when the model re-invokes function-calling after a validation error it can change args. We should surface a validation error back to the model/client and avoid auto-retrying the external tool.

maria: Customer also asked about refunds — billing says duplicate charges need reconciliation. @billing-bot any thoughts?

billing-bot: alert: Created billing case #B-4523 for acme-co; recommended refund for pay_456. Please attach logs and customer confirmation.

ingrid: Repro steps I've used in staging: 
1) Trigger function-call with args missing idempotency_key.
2) Mock payments gateway to return 502 but still create a charge on backend for attempt 1.
3) Let runtime auto-retry -> observe two charges.

cURL example to repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"r-infer-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"charge order ord_123"}],"functions":[{"name":"process_payment","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"},"idempotency_key":{"type":"string"}}}],"function_call":{"name":"process_payment","arguments":"{\"order_id\":\"ord_123\",\"amount\":100}"}}'
```

samir: Action items:
- eng-runtime: add runtime-generated idempotency header + dedupe by call_id (P0)
- eng-platform: add config toggle per-customer to disable auto tool retries and expose in Console (P1)
- support: coordinate refunds with billing and confirm customer mitigation (P0)
- devex: update docs and quickstart to recommend idempotency for any tool that causes side effects (P1)

jordan: I can own the runtime change. Quick temporary patch: if function schema includes `idempotency_key` as optional, runtime will populate it before sending and mark request as safe-to-retry.

maria: Thanks. @jordan please post PR link once ready and I'll coordinate with infra for a canary rollout to acme-co only.

jordan: Will do — aiming for PR today. Also adding a telemetry metric to count "toolcall_retries_with_side_effects" so we can detect regressions.

alex: Nice. Also adding a unit test: simulate a 502-with-side-effect and verify we don't double-execute when idempotency present.

samir: Closing loop: customer is paused on payments for now. We'll follow up after refund and the runtime patch. Keeping thread open until refund confirmed. :thumbsup:
